chunks: It is verily He who initiates and repeats.

key_terms.وَيُعِيدُ: And He repeats or restores after death
key_terms.يُبْدِئُ: He initiates or brings into existence from nothing

ai.seo_question: What does it mean that Allah initiates and repeats?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores Allah's absolute sovereignty over the cosmic cycle of creation and resurrection, often linked with the concept of *Ba'th* (resurrection) as a fundamental tenet of faith. The distinction between *ibda'* (initial creation from non-existence) and *i'idad* (repetition or restoration) highlights the divine power to recreate the soul and body, affirming the reality of the Hereafter.
